user.title: Counterparty Logos
user.description: Logos for bank transaction counterparties. Names from every entity with a `transactions` attribute are matched to brand domains, and the results are cached. Overrides go in `counterparty_logos.yaml` in your config directory.

data_description.logo_dev_publishable_key: Used to display logos from img.logo.dev.
data_description.logo_dev_secret_key: Optional. Enables logo.dev's Search API to match names to domains (searched before Brandfetch).
data_description.brandfetch_client_id: Enables Brandfetch's Brand Search API and, if selected, Brandfetch logo images.
data_description.image_provider: Which CDN the logo URLs point to. Logos are hotlinked, never downloaded.
data_description.name_attributes: Keys inside the `transactions` attribute of any entity that hold counterparty names.

error.no_image_provider: Enter a logo.dev publishable key or a Brandfetch client ID.
error.required_for_provider: Required for the selected image provider.
